name: Depthshaker Titan
clause: Each artifact creature you control has melee, trample, and haste.

needs.proposedSignature: Amount.count gains 'opponents-attacked-this-combat'; Keyword gains 'melee'; KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS gains 'melee': 'whenever ~ attacks, it gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each opponent you attacked this combat'.
needs.semantics: The count is the number of opponents the ability's controller attacked this combat, so melee becomes { on: 'attacks', self: true } -> { op: 'pump', target: 'self', power: { count: 'opponents-attacked-this-combat' }, toughness: the same, duration: 'eot' }. As a Keyword it can also be granted by an anthem ('Other creatures you control have melee.').
